t: Titta Karakorpi | Director, Writer, Actress
s: Titta Karakorpi was born on 29 October 1944 in Oulu, Finland. She is a director and writer, known for Linna (1986), Täällä Pohjantähden alla (1968) and Summer Rebellion (1970). She has been married to Angelos von Martens since 6 August 1986. They have two children.
